# hostinger_vps_virtual_machine_nameservers (Resource)

Manages the nameservers of a VPS virtual machine in the Hostinger account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ns1` (String) The primary nameserver IP address for the VPS virtual machine.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) The ID of the VPS virtual machine.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `ns2` (String) The secondary nameserver IP address for the VPS virtual machine.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `wait_for_action` (Boolean, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Whether to wait for the action to complete before returning. Defaults to true.
